dropped: the non-zero elements keep their order (subsequence, recursive definition)
after the first zero every element is zero (quantifier)
the number of zeroes is unchanged (count)
remarks: Stated: the result has the input's length. The length parameters are named X_len, which the checker reads in the older spelling without assuming 0 <= X_len; requires(0 <= X_len) states it (a list length is a Nat).
